# Legacy GitHub workflows — 2026-10-02

These files are an inert verbatim archive of the software-catalog publication workflows that existed before the intentional-certification / intentional-publication overhaul.

They are historical evidence only and are not executed by GitHub Actions from this directory.

The archived workflows publish obsolete 0.x/1.x Agent prereleases and include ordinary main-push triggers. Do not reactivate them.

A future current Agent PREPRODUCTION publication workflow must be explicit-only, exact-source-SHA driven, and must publish only immutable artifacts whose trust/provenance has been intentionally certified.
